Xiong_Ferrell_2003.title: A positive-feedback-based bistable memory module that governs a cell fate decision

Smolen_Baxter_Byrne_2009.title: Interlinked dual-time feedback loops can enhance robustness to stochasticity and persistence of memory
Smolen_Baxter_Byrne_2009.use: Primary precedent for effective cooperative activation/deactivation models and noise analysis. Current single-loop equations and numbers are an explicitly separate hypothesis.
